test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

"The documents are being submitted by the secretary."

options.text: The secretary has submitted the documents.
the secretary is submitting the documents.
The secretary was submitting the documents.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The documents are being submitted by the secretary."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "the secretary" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "are being submitted" to "is submitting" (present continuous active).

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The secretary is submitting the documents."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The secretary submits the documents." – Incorrect tense (simple present active).
 
• **Option 2: **"The secretary has submitted the documents." – Incorrect tense (present perfect active).
 
• **Option 4: **"The secretary was submitting the documents." – Incorrect tense (past continuous active).
